summary: Kohl's Corporation filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to its revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo. The amendment extends the maturity from the effective date to June 30, 2031, simplifies the pricing grid by replacing two availability breakpoints with one 50% threshold (Base Rate margin 0.25%-0.50%; SOFR margin 1.25%-1.50%), removes a 0.10% credit spread adjustment, adds an in-transit inventory basket up to 15% of the borrowing base, and reduces availability by a Debt Maturity Reserve. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. Terms are procedural; no deal terms or strategic change apply.
